video_caption: The video opens with an orange KTM motorcycle being ridden along a winding asphalt road cut into a vast, barren mountainous landscape, under a clear sky. A close-up shows the motorcyclist, dressed in an orange and black helmet and suit, leaning sharply into a turn. The scene shifts to the motorcyclist on foot, retrieving the fallen orange KTM bike from the roadside, with the overlay text "RUKON VLOG #53 POR BAGOROS. KTM" (English: RUKON VLOG #53 BY BAGOROS. KTM). He then performs a wheelie next to rusty barrels and rides on a dusty, gravel path, kicking up debris. The focus shifts to an orange Nissan pickup truck driving on a rocky track, past two backpackers, then through a shallow river, creating splashes. Following this, a white KTM service truck, branded with "KTM SERVICE" and "ROARING GEARS KTM," navigates the same river, with its driver in an orange helmet visible. The video then presents sweeping shots of the stark mountain ranges, a solitary white horse grazing on a snowy hillside, and an aerial view of a suspension bridge adorned with prayer flags stretching across a dry riverbed between towering peaks. The segment concludes with a man wearing a black beanie and white t-shirt, excitedly speaking to the camera on a dusty mountain road, pointing to the approaching white KTM service truck and explaining that his freestyle bike is inside, set to be ridden high in the mountains.

The video opens with an aerial shot of a suspension bridge, with livestock crossing over a wide, shallow river in a vast, arid mountainous landscape under a bright sky. It transitions to a white Mahindra Bolero pickup truck, marked "KTM SERVICE" on the roof and "ROARING GEARS" on the side and hood, driving on a rough dirt road through a rugged valley, then on a paved section of road, and finally on a desolate dirt track against a backdrop of imposing mountains. A person wearing a brown hooded jacket meticulously applies a custom "DUKE" decal to an orange and black KTM motorcycle. The scene then shows a man in a dark hooded jacket, black pants, and knee pads kneeling in front of the truck, speaking enthusiastically to the camera about riding his "freestyle Duke" to the highest point in the Mustang area and performing tricks, while another crew member prepares the bike. The KTM motorcycle, customized with an Akrapovic exhaust, orange levers, stunt pegs, and a Nepali flag decal, is carefully unloaded from the truck, with close-ups highlighting its details. An aerial view reveals multiple KTM support vehicles parked alongside a road in the barren landscape. The segment concludes with two men, one in a blue hooded puffer jacket and the other in a black hooded jacket and glasses, speaking next to the motorcycle and truck, with a large orange KTM duffel bag and another crew member in an orange jacket visible in the background.

The video opens in a barren, rocky landscape where a man in a black jacket, black hat, and glasses is speaking and gesturing animatedly to another man in a blue puffer jacket and glasses. A black and orange KTM motorcycle is parked behind them, and branded KTM luggage is visible beside an open case revealing a white drone. The man in black explains that it's illegal for foreigners to fly drones, and he gestures towards the drone and the man in blue, who responds with a hand gesture as if flying a drone, implying he will operate it. Both men smile and shake hands. The scene then transitions to a close-up of a rugged, light-colored mountain face dotted with numerous small, dark cave-like openings before cutting back to a different pair of men shaking hands. The man on the left is wearing a black beanie, black and orange motorcycle jacket, and glasses, while the man on the right, holding a motorcycle helmet, wears a black puffer jacket; both are smiling in the same desolate, mountainous setting.

The video opens with two men on a mountainous road, one wearing a black beanie and an orange and black KTM jacket, the other in a black puffer jacket holding a white and black helmet, fist-bumping and discussing something. More men join, some also wearing helmets. The man in the beanie praises the man in the puffer jacket, calling him a "true rocker" after he reportedly traveled 750 kilometers to meet him, and they shake hands. The scene then transitions to aerial shots of a winding road through a barren, mountainous landscape. A man, wearing an orange and black helmet, black and orange riding gear, black pants with knee pads, and grey sneakers, is shown riding an orange and black KTM Duke motorcycle, performing various stunts on both dirt and paved roads. He executes wheelies, drifts, and sharp turns, kicking up dust in the dry environment. At one point, he attempts a stunt near a pile of rusty barrels, loses balance, and falls with the motorcycle; another person quickly helps him lift it. The video includes helmet-cam footage as the rider navigates winding mountain roads, passing a smoke-emitting tractor and a group of onlookers. Later, shots of a traditional mountain village, a temple/monastery, and horses with colorful blankets appear, highlighting the local culture. The rider, in a close-up, is seen wearing his "Scorpion EXO" helmet and goggles before speeding off again, performing a jump over a small hump, and finally stopping to look back at the scenic mountain village.

A man in a black and orange motorcycle jacket, black pants, and yellow gloves is initially seen putting on his orange and white full-face helmet next to an orange and black motorcycle. He adjusts the helmet, then removes it, placing it on the motorcycle's fuel tank. The man, also wearing an orange neck gaiter, faces the camera and talks, gesturing with his hands as he leans on the motorcycle. His expression is engaging, and he smiles at the end of the segment. The motorcycle is clearly a KTM, indicated by its characteristic orange color and a visible logo on his jacket. The background features a vast, arid, and rocky mountainous landscape under a clear blue sky, suggesting a high-altitude, remote location. Another piece of equipment or motorcycle, fitted with a camera, is partially visible to the right of the frame.

A man with short blonde hair, wearing a black and orange motorcycle jacket, black pants with knee pads, and yellow gloves, crouches down in the foreground. He is looking directly at the camera, speaking with an earnest expression, his mouth open. To his left, part of an orange and black KTM motorcycle with a helmet is visible. To his right, a large grey oxygen tank with a regulator and tubing sits on a wooden table, next to a plastic water bottle. A GoPro camera is mounted on the oxygen tank, pointing towards the man. The background reveals a bright, sunny day with a clear blue sky and a barren, mountainous landscape, suggesting a high-altitude or remote outdoor setting.

In a bright, arid outdoor setting with clear blue skies and distant mountains, a man with short blonde hair, dressed in a black and orange motorcycle jacket, black pants, and yellow and black gloves, crouches beside an orange and black KTM motorcycle. He speaks directly to the camera with an intense expression and uses hand gestures, at one point pointing his right hand towards the viewer. To his right, a tall, black oxygen tank with "KOC" written on it is visible, equipped with a regulator and a clear humidifier-like attachment. A GoPro camera is mounted on top of the oxygen tank, also facing the man.

The video opens at 00:01 with a blond-haired man in a black and orange motorcycle jacket and gloves kneeling beside an orange and black KTM motorcycle. He is talking to the camera, gesturing with his hands, with a large gray oxygen tank and a GoPro camera visible behind him, all set against a backdrop of dry, rocky mountains and a clear blue sky. At 00:13, the same man sits at a wooden table with another man wearing a black beanie and a black hoodie. On the table, two smartphones are mounted on a tripod; one is vertical, displaying an app with the text "HILDON" and a prominent reading of "3664.02m" at 00:20, indicating altitude and other metrics. The men discuss preparing "two phones" for "time" and "altitude," looking at the camera, then fist-bumping as the blond-haired man asks, "Are you ready?" The scene briefly transitions to a wide shot of the arid mountainous landscape under a bright sky at 00:31. Then, at 00:32, the blond-haired man removes his black and orange motorcycle jacket, revealing a grey and black long-sleeved shirt with orange accents and "GE X" branding, while talking about his "lucky jacket" and smiling at the camera, with a village and snow-capped mountains in the background. He then hands the jacket to the other man in the beanie and puts on a denim vest over his shirt at 00:39. Finally, at 00:42, he turns to face the camera, now wearing the denim vest over his long-sleeved shirt and an orange and red bandana around his neck, smiling and then looking towards a group of spectators gathered on a high bank, with the same mountainous scenery in the background.

The video opens with a man in a grey vest and orange scarf, standing in a mountainous, arid landscape with snow-capped peaks in the distance, addressing a group of people sitting on a hill. He gestures towards them, stating, "Let's do the world record. My KTM family. You ready? Without them, I wouldn't be here, so thank you guys. So let's make the world record!" The scene then transitions to two smartphones acting as stopwatches, with one displaying "00:00.00" as a man on an orange and black KTM motorcycle, wearing a full-face helmet, a grey vest with "FULL THROTTLE RIDE AND RALLY" on the back, and black protective gear, prepares for a stunt. He then performs various intricate motorcycle stunts, including prolonged wheelies (riding on the back wheel), riding while standing on the seat, standing on the handlebars, performing controlled slides with his foot on the ground, and nose wheelies (on the front wheel), all against the stunning backdrop of towering, snow-covered mountains and dry, rocky terrain. Spectators, including men in puffer jackets and a crew member holding an umbrella, watch intently, some filming with their phones. A white SUV is often visible in the background. At one point, the rider performs a burnout, creating a cloud of smoke from the rear tire, and the smartphone timer shows "20:06.31" and "20:07.31." He is then seen interacting with a man in a black and grey hoodie, exchanging high-fives and continuing stunts. Finally, the rider is surrounded by the cheering crowd, who embrace and congratulate him. He points to the tire marks on the asphalt, smiles, and says, "I see only white spots. This is the hardest show." The video features text overlays like "FOLLOW ME: @ROKBAGOROS" (an Instagram handle) encouraging viewers to follow the stunt rider.

In a bright, sunny outdoor setting with arid mountains and a small village in the background, a group of men is gathered, mostly of Asian descent, with several wearing black puffer jackets and some sporting sunglasses. The central figure, a man wearing an orange, black, and white motorcycle helmet with "SCORPION" text and a GoPro camera attached, speaks excitedly, gesturing with yellow and black gloves. He gives a thumbs-up, points, and then puts his arms around two other men, one in a black beanie and grey hoodie, and another in a black puffer jacket and sunglasses, both smiling. The man in the helmet announces, "We did it. It was worth it. We cannot say sure that the world record is done, we need to send the video to the Guinness World Records, right, Michael? Come here, man. KTM Nepal, those are the guys that brought us here to make this possible." A motorcycle is partially visible to the right, reinforcing the context of a motorcycle-related event, possibly a world record attempt supported by "KTM Nepal."

The video opens outdoors in a mountainous, barren landscape under a bright sky, where a group of about ten men are gathered. On the left, a man in a black beanie and a grey and black hoodie speaks while gesturing. In the center, a man wearing an orange and black full-face motorcycle helmet, a grey jacket, and yellow and black gloves speaks and points with his right hand. Other men, mostly in puffer jackets and sunglasses, stand around them, looking engaged and smiling. The scene then cuts to the same group posing for a photo. The man previously in the helmet is now seated on a black and orange KTM Duke 250 motorcycle, making a "rock on" hand gesture with both hands, while the other men around him also smile and make similar gestures. Behind them, majestic snow-capped mountains are visible under a clear blue sky. The video then transitions to a close-up of the man who was on the motorcycle. He has blonde hair, a short beard, and is wearing a black hoodie under a black denim vest with an "AC/DC" patch, an orange bandana, and orange and black gloves. He speaks directly to the camera, gesturing with his hands, and initially holds a plastic bottle with a pink liquid. The background continues to show the dry, mountainous terrain with distant buildings, white SUVs, vans, and prominent tire marks on the ground.

The video begins with a fair-skinned man with short, light-colored hair and a beard, wearing a grey hoodie under a denim vest and an orange neck gaiter, speaking animatedly to the camera in a mountain landscape with snow-capped peaks in the background. He gestures with his gloved right hand, showing an "ACDC" patch on his vest. He is soon joined by another fair-skinned man with dark hair, a black beanie, and a black and grey hoodie, who laughs beside him, and then a third fair-skinned man with glasses, a black beanie, and a similar hooded jacket, who puts his arm around the first man. All three men smile and make "rock on" hand gestures while standing on a paved area with cars and other people in the distance. An older man with darker skin, a red mark on his forehead, and wearing a patterned scarf then joins the group, also smiling, as the three younger men continue their enthusiastic gestures. The scene fades to an end screen featuring a close-up of an orange and black KTM motorcycle parked in a desolate, rocky terrain with mountains in the distance. Overlaid on the screen are the words "SUBSCRIBE", "WATCH MORE", and "SHOP NOW" in white, along with a white logo that reads "ROK BAGOROS". The motorcycle displays various stickers, including "KTM", "MAGURA", "Akrapovic", and a flag-like emblem with a red symbol on its front fender.
